integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus of an algebraic C* action; projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: Binary-separated diagonal weights give one projective fixed point for every dual Plucker coordinate; replacing two indices constructs a tangency witness for each coordinate hyperplane.
integrity.object_basis: Shimada studies complements of Grassmannian dual varieties; Holweck explicitly defines and studies the projective dual of the Plucker Grassmannian.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival Grassmannian-dual source arXiv:0906.1074 lists 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification 14F35, 14D05.
integrity.tangent_basis: At a coordinate Plucker point e_J, the affine tangent cone is wedge^{k-1}J wedge C^n, spanned by e_K with |K intersection J| at least k-1.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes ordinary Euler characteristic only, not Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, degree, or singular strata.
It excludes k=1 and k=n-1, where the Grassmannian is projective space and the projective dual is empty.
The proof is short after choosing a separating one-parameter subgroup, so an older unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: The dual of every nonprojective Plücker Grassmannian has ambient Euler characteristic
